scientific_limitations: Exact optimizer multiplicities only for labelled equal-arm spiders of lengths three, four, and five, arm count at least three and integer demand at least one. Does not count orbits or solve arbitrary nonuniform spider optimization. Known optimum-weight statements are not claimed new; possible equivalent unindexed enumerations remain a priority risk.
title: Exponential-to-polynomial optimal-multicover multiplicity across three spider lengths
